messages.subject: Project Onyx — EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Howard,

I'm pleased to confirm we exchanged contracts at 2.50 pm today on the agreed terms. Completion is fixed for 7 April 2026. The deposit of £1,865,000 has been released to Marlowe Greaves to hold as stakeholder. We'll now move to the pre-completion steps: engrossing the transfer, OS1 priority search, and agreeing the completion statement and apportionments.

Congratulations on getting here.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0531
